title: 6 Bellview Heights, Mullingar, Co. Westmeath, N91P9N2
seoTitle: 6 Bellview Heights, Mullingar, Co. Westmeath, N91P9N2
description:
A well-presented and versatile 3/4 bedroom semi-detached home, ideally positioned in a mature and established residential location just off the Dublin Road. No. 6 Bellview Heights is within easy walking distance of Mullingar town centre and a host of local amenities, including Aldi, Bellview Medical Centre and St Colman’s National School.

Offering flexible accommodation over two floors, together with a detached garage incorporating a home office, this property is ideally suited to first-time buyers, families or those looking to downsize.

Accommodation

Ground Floor

Kitchen/Dining Room
A bright and practical kitchen/dining space with access to the sunroom, providing an excellent area for everyday family living and entertaining.

Sunroom
A useful additional living space overlooking the rear garden and providing direct access to the outdoor area.

Utility Room
Convenient separate utility area with space for laundry and storage.

Sitting Room
A comfortable reception room featuring with Fireplace creating a warm and inviting focal point.

Bathroom
Ground-floor bathroom facilities.

Playroom / Bedroom / Home Office
A particularly versatile room which could be used as a children's playroom, fourth bedroom, home office or additional living space, depending on the purchaser's requirements.

First Floor

Bedroom 1
A well-proportioned double bedroom.

Bedroom 2
A further good-sized bedroom.

Bedroom 3
A third bedroom suitable for family, guest or office use.

Family Bathroom
Main bathroom serving the first-floor bedrooms.

Outside

To the rear, the property enjoys a private, non-overlooked garden, a particularly attractive feature of the home. There is a composite decking area, providing an ideal space for outdoor dining, entertaining or simply relaxing.

The property also benefits from a detached garage, part of which has been converted into a home office. This provides valuable additional workspace and storage away from the main house. This represents a great opportunity for a variety of purchasers to acquire a quality home in a great neighbourhood. Viewing is highly recommended.
